intro.text: A listener of the noble First-Rhythm family, Keeper of Songs and mother of Eshonai and Venli.
A listener Keeper of Songs and the mother of Eshonai and Venli, whose memory has been failing for years. She survived the fall of Narak with a band of dissenters.
A listener Keeper of Songs and the mother of Eshonai and Venli, whose failing mind was restored when she bonded a spren and became a Willshaper.

items.text: As Keeper of Songs, perhaps the most important job in the family, Jaxlim needed no other work, but she kept busy anyway: working her hands kept her body strong, she said, while the songs worked her mind. She taught the songs to both her daughters, but when Eshonai gave up she focused on Venli, and she spoke for Venli before the Five when Venli sought warform.

Soon after the listeners began meeting humans, Jaxlim's memory started to fail. At first only Venli knew, and Jaxlim sent people to her to hear the songs. Her illness was part of why Venli searched for warform, hoping a new form might save her mind, and as she worsened Jaxlim agreed to try it.

Eshonai went into the storm with her, but Jaxlim could not attune the rhythms and did not transform, though she enjoyed the experience. Eshonai took the new form instead. Jaxlim's illness advanced quickly; she wept for what she was losing, and at times believed her daughters were small children again.

During the war, Jaxlim lived in a shack on the edge of Narak, tending her shalebark gardens. She did not always recognise Eshonai, but when asked about the listeners leaving the "dark home" she sang a song of their history, and gave Eshonai maps of Natanatan she had drawn in her youth.
When the listeners who refused stormform were rounded up, Jaxlim escaped into the chasms with Thude and the other dissenters.
After the Battle of Narak, the listeners Jaxlim had fled with survived with the help of a chasmfiend.
When Venli found her mother again, she felt joy and hope that Jaxlim might become Radiant and have her mind healed. That love helped Venli reach her next Ideal.

By the time Venli returned, Jaxlim no longer recognised her. But after bonding one of the lightspren Venli had brought, her mind and memories were fully restored, and she tried to persuade Leshwi to turn her back on Odium completely.
Once recovered, Jaxlim admitted she felt partly to blame for Venli's path, having taught her about the forms of power.

appearance.text: In old age she keeps a solid build, though she sometimes seems frail. She has a neat round face and braids her hair strands, tying them with a ribbon Eshonai gave her.

In her youth, Jaxlim was strong and fit, with a complex skin pattern of wavy red and black lines like marbled stone, among the most beautiful in the camp. Her voice was thin and sharp as a knife, and her memory was once among the best in the city.

personality.text: Jaxlim prefers workform and keeps it even as new forms are found, believing her people should not value any form above another lest they divide by rank. She sings often, in a calming, sonorous voice.
She spends many hours drilling Venli on every stanza of the songs, pushes her when she fears failure, and suggests she learn the human language.
Before the humans were found, she thought Eshonai's scouting silly and her daughter flighty; afterwards, she spoke of Eshonai with praise and respect.
